endcard: Save this for the day you feel unheard

save.ar:
وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِى عَنِّى فَإِنِّى قَرِيبٌ ۖ
أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ
save.tr: “And when My servants ask you, [O Muḥammad], concerning Me - indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me.”

lines.say: Right in the middle of the Qur'an's verses on fasting, there's one verse that isn't a rule at all.
lines.cap: In the middle of the fasting verses, one verse isn't a rule at all

lines.say: It's Allah telling you how near He is.
Allah says: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me.
lines.cap: “Indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant”

lines.say: And in another verse: Your Lord says, Call upon Me; I will respond to you.
lines.cap: “Call upon Me; I will respond to you”

lines.say: Ibn Kathir explains: by His grace and kindness, Allah encourages His servants to call upon Him, and He guarantees to respond.
lines.cap: Allah encourages His servants to call upon Him, and He guarantees to respond

lines.say: Sufyan ath-Thawri used to call Him: O You who love most those who ask of You.
lines.cap: “O You Who love most those who ask of You”

lines.say: So whatever you're carrying tonight, don't carry it alone. Ask Him. He is near.
lines.cap: Don't carry it alone. Ask Him. He is near.

lines.say: Save this for the day you feel unheard, and send it to someone who needs it.
lines.cap: Save this for the day you feel unheard & send it 🤍
